mapper.sql: org_id, enabled, allowed_tool_mask, maximum_daily_cap, maximum_per_run_cap, state_version, kill_epoch
mapper.select: SELECT FROM organization_ai_standing_approval_policy WHERE org_id = #{orgId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM organization_ai_standing_approval_policy WHERE org_id = #{orgId} FOR SHARE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_ai_standing_approval_policy (org_id) SELECT id FROM organization WHERE id = #{orgId} AND lifecycle_state = 'active' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE org_id = organization_ai_standing_approval_policy.org_id
mapper.select: SELECT o.id FROM organization o WHERE o.id > #{afterOrgId} AND o.lifecycle_state = 'active' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM organization_ai_standing_approval_policy p WHERE p.org_id = o.id) ORDER BY o.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT om.user_id FROM org_member om JOIN organization o ON o.id = om.org_id JOIN app_user u ON u.id = om.user_id WHERE om.org_id = #{orgId} AND om.org_role IN ('owner', 'admin') AND o.lifecycle_state = 'active' AND (u.account_deletion_reservation_until IS NULL OR u.account_deletion_reservation_until <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY om.user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE organization_ai_standing_approval_policy SET enabled = #{enabled}, allowed_tool_mask = #{allowedToolMask}, maximum_daily_cap = #{maximumDailyCap}, maximum_per_run_cap = #{maximumPerRunCap}, state_version = #{stateVersion}, kill_epoch = #{killEpoch} WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND state_version = #{stateVersion} - 1
